text: 8月1日，中国人民银行召开2026年下半年工作会议。会议强调，要实施好适度宽松的货币政策，充分发挥各项存量政策效能，及时谋划出台务实管用的增量政策，加大逆周期调节力度，加力扩大内需、优化供给，扎实做好下半年各项重点工作，推动经济持续向新向优向好发展。
text_en: On Aug 1, the People's Bank of China held its H2 2026 work conference. The meeting emphasized implementing a moderately loose monetary policy well, fully leveraging the effectiveness of existing stock policies, promptly planning and introducing pragmatic and effective incremental policies, intensifying counter-cyclical adjustment, increasing efforts to expand domestic demand and improve supply, solidly carrying out key H2 work, and promoting sustained development of the economy toward innovation, quality, and improvement.
